_about: Content plan: pillars and their shares, topics, platforms and weekly pace. Read by scripts/content_calendar.py. Keep it in content-studio/content-plan.json in the working folder. Change it only with the owner's decision. Keys starting with _ are notes.
_status: proposed = not yet approved by the owner: ideas and drafts are allowed, but no row may be scheduled or published. After approval set status to approved with the owner's name and the date.
_open: Fill these from the owner's answers only. Never guess them.
_week_starts: First day of the working week: Mon, Sun or Sat.
_topics: Optional. Your product or service lines, for pillars that cover one line per post. Example: {"cctv": {"name": "CCTV"}, "access": {"name": "Access control"}}. With video_endings, a topic may also carry "ending": "camera".

pillars.name: Who we are
pillars.purpose: The fixed introduction of the brand, in its approved wording

pillars.name: What we do
pillars.purpose: One product or service explained simply: what it is, when it is needed, what we offer

pillars.name: Before you buy
pillars.purpose: A practical tip for the customer. Facts are checked by the owner; no claims

pillars.name: How we work
pillars.purpose: Our method, step by step. No client names without written permission

pillars.name: Where to find us
pillars.purpose: Service area and how to get in touch

_pillars: A starting proposal. Agree three to five pillars with the owner; shares must add up to 100. Set needs_topic to true on a pillar that must name one topic per post. Content outside the pillars needs the owner's approval and a plan change.
_platforms: per_week = [lowest, highest] posts per week. days = proposed posting days for each pace. These are placeholders to agree with the owner, not advice. Remove platforms you do not use. Optional per platform: "visual_must_be": "real".
_visuals: generated = AI-generated picture or clip, shown as illustrative. real = a real photo or clip with confirmed rights. brand-card = a card in the brand colours with no picture.
_video_endings: Optional. To check that every video row names one closing clip, add: "video_endings": {"default": "brand"} and, where a topic has its own ending, "ending" on that topic.
